Name: R_t
Value: time-varying; piecewise constant with changes at interventions
Description: Effective reproduction number; modeled as a function of the initial reproduction number and intervention effects.

Name: R_0
Description: Initial reproduction number before interventions took effect.

Name: infection fatality ratio
Value: population-averaged; adjusted for age structure and contact patterns
Description: Fraction of infections resulting in death.

Name: infection-to-death distribution
Value: derived from onset-to-symptoms and symptoms-to-death distributions
Description: Delay distribution linking infections to observed deaths.

Name: generation time distribution
Value: approximated using the serial interval distribution
Description: Distribution weighting the discrete convolution of previous infections in the renewal equation.

Name: serial interval distribution
Value: used as approximation to generation time distribution
Description: Distribution of time between symptom onset in a primary case and a secondary case.

Name: intervention effects
Value: country-shared with partial pooling for the last intervention
Description: Covariate effects of governmental interventions on transmission, including lockdown, public events banned, school closure, self isolation, and social distancing encouraged.
